description: View GitHub issue for a given repository and organization.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Get various details about issue depending upon action specified. Choices: "get_status" ← (default)

parameters.name: issue
parameters.description: Issue number for which information is required.

parameters.name: organization
parameters.description: Name of the GitHub organization in which the repository is hosted.

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: Name of repository from which issue needs to be retrieved.

examples:
- name: Check if GitHub issue is closed or not
  community.general.github_issue:
    organization: ansible
    repo: ansible
    issue: 23642
    action: get_status
  register: r

- name: Take action depending upon issue status
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: Do something when issue 23642 is open
  when: r.issue_status == 'open'

return_values.name: issue_status
return_values.description: State of the GitHub issue. Returned: success Sample: "open, closed"
